[LUNI.8.7.3] **Dimension is tracked independently of leaf kind.** The static
leaf kind of a `::<unit>` cast ([LCST.4] — the Int/Float/String/Bool/Json
classification) is the kind its dimension's storage gives ([LUNI.4.1.1]):
`Float` for `storage float64`, `Int` for `storage int64` or `int32`. Its dimension
is the target unit's per [LUNI.8.7.1]. A unit-typed slot access and a `::<unit>`
cast therefore report the same pair: the storage's leaf kind, and the unit's
dimension. A quantity in an `int64` dimension (`data`, a currency) is
an `Int` with a dimension, and arithmetic on it is `Int` arithmetic
([LEXP.7.3]). A value of the `time` dimension is a `Duration` ([LTIM.1.3.5]),
held in the same storage. The two facets are independent: the leaf kind drives the [LEXP.7.7]
bitwise / numeric-operand checks, the dimension drives the [LUNI.8.1]–[LUNI.8.4]
checks.
